newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece sets price for OTE telecom stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Greece sets price for OTE telecom stake sale.

text.p: Shares of Greece's telecom firm OTE will be offered to institutional investors at 6,200-6,900 drachmas per share in the June 9-11 book-building, the global coordinator and lead underwriter National Bank of Greece said in a statement.

"The National Bank of Greece announces on behalf of the Greek State and Lead Underwriters that the issue price of OTE's shares to institutional investors will range between 6,200-6,900 drachmas per share," it said.
Retail investors will be offered OTE's shares at the June 11-13 public offering at a range of 6,000-6,700 drachmas per share.
"The issue price of OTE's shares at the public offering, which mostly concerns retail investors, will range between 6,000-6,700 drachmas per share," National Bank said.
The Greek state, currently the owner of 92.43 percent of OTE's share capital, is offering a total of 45 million shares -- 10.7 percent.
But depending on demand conditions, the State may increase the size of the offering by 2,109,977 shares and global coordinators may allocate an extra 6.33 million shares at their discretion.

Subscribers to the public offering, retail or institutional, are ensured an allocation of up to 100 shares, but a lower allocation may come about if the value of total shares demanded exceeds 100 billion drachmas. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
